notes.title: Brewpub Simulator announced – new game coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Quit your day job, open a bar! 

We’re celebrating International Beer Day (yes, we know it’s tomorrow) with a new game about crafting beer!

[previewyoutube=kw6uf0yrJaE;full][/previewyoutube]

Brew lagers, stouts and IPAs, and serve patrons at your own brewpub. Decorate the place, create your own brands of beer, and expand into the best joint in town. All of this in a relaxing simulator that values creativity and passion for crafting.

Wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

Brew your dream beer! Discover new recipes, buy ingredients and unlock more advanced equipment
Unlock new furniture and decorations and customise your pub
Earn reputation, attract new customers and keep your returning patrons satisfied
Master each step of a realistic process of brewing craft beers
Play multiple minigames, including pouring beer, changing kegs, mixing ingredients, bottling beer, and more
Manage your business, hire employees and keep your pub fully stocked
Take on daily missions to earn more money and experience

notes.title: Lust from Beyond: M Edition announced at E3!
notes.content:
For all of you who couldn’t put your hands on Lust from Beyond. 
For those who never heard about the dark, mysterious world of Lusst’ghaa.

[previewyoutube=WCmgncH28yY;full][/previewyoutube]

M Edition is a new version of Lust from Beyond, our esoteric survival horror. It’s tailored for those who love Lovecraftian stories for their atmosphere and lore rather than explicit content.

notes.title: OUT NOW! With special DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
This is the day, Cultists! Lust from Beyond has cometh! 
Grab it while it's hot, as we all know - it is hot, as hell itself!

[previewyoutube=oKSrkABgKB4;full][/previewyoutube]

“I'm happy and proud of Lust from Beyond. Personally, I'm tired of horror titles that circle around the same old themes. I'm happy to deliver a long, complex, fully independent production that goes against the mainstream and isn't afraid to get graphic, while staying focused on its narrative.”

“The development wasn't without its tougher moments. Fortunately, we've always had our fans' support. Their passion and encouragement kept up our fighting spirit. There are hundreds of posts on our Discord, about the lore, about the gameplay. Each gave us more strength and made us work even harder to meet the expectations. It's a game about lust, but we made it with love.”


Embrace the Discounts!

- Our Launch Discount: 10% for EVERYONE, thanks to your engagement in the Community Challenge

notes.title: A COUPLE OF THOUGHTS FROM US, THE DEVELOPERS
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Before we write anything, we would like to thank you once again for buying and playing Lust for Darkness. Your comments, suggestions, reports and advice are all extremely valuable to us and we read them with humility.

We would like to take this opportunity to address several topics that you seem to be raising most frequently.

DURATION OF THE GAME
When we were creating Lust for Darkness we wanted to tell a specific story. We didn’t want to introduce any unnecessary fillers that wouldn’t add anything to the game world and we didn’t want to make the story longer just so that you spend more time with the game. If you take a close look, you can notice that each level in Lust for Darkness serves a particular role. Adding a new section where a player escapes from monsters or coming up with a new puzzle that would take the player a lot of time to solve is not so difficult. But our priority wasn’t to make the game as long as possible. Our priority was to make the gameplay as immersive as possible with a smooth, satisfactory plot-line.

THE STORY
“I finished the game but I still have questions that were left unanswered for me” was something we’ve heard from you relatively often…

Keeping the game in a mysterious vibe and at the same time handing all story piece to a player on a plate wouldn’t make much sense. With the main story, we wanted to focus on the relationship between Jonathan and Amanda, and leave other plotlines for those willing to explore our world more.

That is obviously related to Side Stories — by collecting 5 threads from each Side Story you will be able to see a cutscene that provides an additional explanation. If you already finished the game and don't feel like looking for Side Stories, we want to share one of them with you to give you a better sense of what they contain. From the video below, you will find out why Willard kidnapped Amanda. https://youtu.be/2uwgcoeILbU

It doesn’t end with Side Stories though. You can obtain some “secret information” in plenty of other ways. Who knows, maybe in the future we are going to shed more light on them… Including a full explanation of what really happened at the end of the game.

ISSUES IN THE GAME
We understand that Lust for Darkness is not a perfect game and some of its elements, such as an optimization, could be better. However, please remember that we are an independent studio consisting of only 6 people and this is our first game ever. Furthermore, none of our team members has really had any prior commercial experience in the videogame industry. We did our best with Lust for Darkness and we promise to get only better in the future. We are also still working on new updates for the game, the next one should introduce Steam Trading Cards, among other things.

THE IMPORTANCE OF REVIEWS FOR US
We've already stated that a few times but we can't really stress it enough. Reviews that you can submit on Steam are extremely important to us. Today, Lust for Darkness reached a "Mixed" rating which caused our organic reach on Steam to drop drastically. And by drastically, we mean really drastically. We are only 1% away from the "Positive" score so any new positive review from you or, if you decide to change your review from a negative into a positive one, means A LOT to us.

Naturally, if you really dislike our game, we understand and respect it, and in this case we do not encourage you to change your score by any means. However, if you gave us a negative rating but you think that we've got some potential or you don't really know whether you can recommend our game or not, please reconsider your rating. A higher rating leads to better exposure on Steam, which in turn leads to higher sales, which ultimately will give us more resources to make a better second game and continue working on developing the erotic horror genre. 

Thanks for your continuous support, we are both proud and humbled to have you as our community!

Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton

notes.title: [CONTEST] WILLARD YELVERTON helps you find all Side Stories
notes.content:
Dear Cultists,

My trained eye has noticed that you generally struggle with finding all Side Stories in Lust for Darkness. I would like to make it easier for you by revealing in what spots they have been distributed. 

The description below may contain spoilers so if you haven't finished the game yet, first complete the main story and then come back here to find out where you can find the Side Stories. (Hoover over the block with your mouse to see the text.)

[spoiler]
JONATHAN'S FLAT
- 1 thread of "Cult of Ecstasy" story

THE ENTRANCE ROOM (from entering the mansion till Amanda's room)
- 1 thread of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story
- 1 thread of “Cult of Ecstasy” story

LUSST’GHAA (from when Jonathan stands up from the floor till the meeting with Amanda)
- 1 thread of “Cult of Ecstasy” story
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE CABINET (from the meeting with Amanda till the Willard's attack in his secret room)
- 3 threads of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story

LUSST’GHAA 2 (from when Jonathan wakes up in Lusst’ghaa till the Stairs of Infinity)
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE GARDEN OF LOVE (from leaving the Stairs of Infinity till the Willard's pursuit)
- 2 threads of “Cult of Ecstasy” story

LUSST’GHAA 3 (from entering the portal after Willard's attack till the fight with Willard)
- 2 threads of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE MONSTER ORGY (from the fight with Willard till descending into the cellar)
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE CELLAR (from descending into the cellar till the meeting with Amanda)
- 1 thread of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story
[/spoiler]

Remember: collecting 5 threads from all Side Stories unlocks extra cutscenes that extend the lore of Lust for Darkness. You can watch this short bit from the “Yelvertons’ Legacy” Side Story to get the idea of what to expect:
https://youtu.be/v8D6fhHC2rs

To give you an extra motivation, the first 10 people that post a screenshot from the game proving they have collected all Side Stories in the Screenshot section of our Steam Community Hub are going to receive 3 prizes from us: a digital artbook, a wallpaper package and a Steam key for the game that you will be able to gift to your family member, a friend, or... a random stranger on the Internet.

Let the search begin!
Y’vh Iauv’abrarc. Y’vh Lusst’ghaa.
Willard Yelverton

notes.title: The first UPDATE and a big THANK YOU!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30060957/b579c997472f7c13e70bdc133d084edbef3e5c2f.png

Dear Cultists,

It's been only 2 days since we released Lust for Darkness and we are extremely humbled to see such a big interest in the game. It's also wonderful to read your enthusiastic opinions about the game, it makes all of us really happy!

We are a very small team of just 6 people and this is our first game created together. It looks like all the effort we've put into it over the last year (and beyond) paid off.

We can't wait for more of you to play Lust for Darkness, and in the meantime we prepared a first update for the game featuring:
- improved collisions system
- fixed glitches
- fixed typos
- improved difficulty level in the Garden of Love

We are currently working on another update, including an option to change the controls as well as Steam achievements. If you have suggestions for what else we should add in the future updates, let us know!

Additionally, if you liked the game, please leave us a review. It improves our visibility on Steam significantly and naturally we want as many people as possible to find out about Lust for Darkness. 

Finally, we love reading your feedback, whether positive or negative, so keep it coming! Your voice is of the highest priority to us, both in terms of improving Lust for Darkness further and developing our next games. 

Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton
